# DATA C0RE

Digital artist and creative technologist based in Annecy, France, working internationally with realtime audiovisual systems, creative coding, interactive video, projection, light, live AV, theatre video and media-system integration.

Canonical site: https://datac0re.is-a.dev/

## Core skills and search concepts
TouchDesigner; realtime audiovisual systems; interactive video; projection mapping; projection integration; creative coding; live AV; GLSL; SMODE; Resolume; Millumin; LED; DMX; Art-Net; OSC; show control; media servers; theatre video; touring video systems; interactive installations; Fusion 360; realtime rendering; audio-reactive systems.

French search vocabulary: technicien vidéo; régie vidéo; régisseur vidéo; vidéo interactive; TouchDesigner; intégration projection; mapping vidéo; projection scénique; systèmes audiovisuels temps réel; installation interactive; lumière interactive; média serveur; spectacle vivant; théâtre; danse; opéra; tournée; LED; DMX; Art-Net; show control.
